# Appeal of Denied Prior Authorization — Request for Reconsideration

**Jordan Hayes**
[Street address]
[City, State ZIP]
[Phone number]
[Email address]

**Date:** [Date of this letter]

**To:** MedStar Family Choice DC — Member Appeals
[Use the appeal address printed on my denial letter, or call the number on the back of my insurance card and ask where member appeals are filed]

**RE: Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-08-03**
- **Member name:** Jordan Hayes
- **Member ID:** W671447302
- **Reference number:** POC-92D596C7F2-83353
- **Denied service:** Lower back disc surgery / decompression, CPT 63030
- **Plan:** MedStar Family Choice DC (Commercial/ACA), District of Columbia
- **Governing policy:** *Utilization Management Criteria* — https://www.medstarfamilychoicedc.com/-/media/project/mho/mfcdc/medical-policies-and-procedures/policy-115dc_utilization-management-criteria.pdf
- **Appeal deadline:** This appeal must be received by 2027-01-30, and I am submitting it within that period.

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of the lower back disc surgery / decompression (CPT 63030) that my surgeon requested for me. The plan's notice of 2026-08-03 states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking MedStar Family Choice DC to reconsider that decision and approve the procedure. My surgeon, Dr. Lindqvist, MD (orthopedic surgery), has documented that this procedure is needed.

I am writing because the prior authorization packet does contain the clinical information a reviewer would need. Below, I list what the records state, item by item, so that nothing has to be searched for.

## The plan's own policy, and what it says about how this decision should be made

The policy that governs this decision is titled *Utilization Management Criteria*. It states:

> "MedStar Family Choice DC follows documented UM criteria to facilitate consistency in UM decision making across all service types."

It also states:

> "MedStar Family Choice DC prior-authorization decisions for medical and behavioral health services, including residential treatment are based on the following criteria:"

and

> "The following criteria and processes, as documented on MedStar Family Choice DC web site, are utilized for UM decision making:"

I want to be straightforward with you about the limits of what I can quote. Both of those sentences end in a colon and introduce lists of criteria that I was not given and cannot reproduce. The policy lists further conditions that are not reproduced in what is available to me, and the plan has not been quoted to me as stating any specific clinical threshold — no required number of weeks of therapy, no required number of visits, no imaging or exam finding, and no documentation checklist. The denial notice also does not identify which document, which finding, or which element was considered missing.

That matters for this appeal. I cannot fill a gap in my file if I have not been told where the gap is. And because no threshold has been stated to me, I am not arguing against a number — I am simply setting out what my records actually contain.

The policy also states:

> "Upon review for medical necessity, requests for ongoing services or treatment that have not demonstrated improvement in condition or benefit to the Enrollee will be subject to denial as not medically necessary."

My records show exactly the pattern this sentence describes: treatment that has been tried and has not produced improvement or lasting benefit. That is the reason surgery has been requested.

## What the records submitted for me contain

Each item below is stated in the prior authorization packet:

| Clinical element | What my records state |
|---|---|
| Symptom duration | 18 months of progressive pain in the lower back, unrelieved by rest |
| Supervised conservative care | Supervised physical therapy including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility, 8 weeks, 2026-04-14 to 2026-06-09, 16 visits completed — documented in the physical therapy discharge note |
| Medication trial | NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief |
| Injection | Corticosteroid injection 2026-04-29, giving 2 weeks of partial relief |
| Imaging | MRI lumbar spine 2026-06-16: L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root |
| Physical examination | Positive provocative testing on the affected side; neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level |
| Functional limitation | Cannot stand more than 10 minutes; radicular pain into the right calf |
| Surgical safety factors | No active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, non-smoker |
| Requesting surgeon | Lindqvist, MD, orthopedic surgery |

Read together, these records document a condition of 18 months' duration, a course of non-surgical treatment that included supervised physical therapy, months of medication, and an injection, and imaging that identifies nerve root compression at a specific level that matches my examination findings. The relief I got from the injection lasted two weeks. The physical therapy course was completed and documented in a discharge note. This is a complete record of conservative treatment that did not work, plus objective imaging and a matching exam finding, plus a documented functional loss.

I would ask the reviewer to identify anything in that list that the plan considers absent, and to tell me so specifically, so that my surgeon and I can respond rather than guess.

## Request for the criteria that were applied to my case

I am asking MedStar Family Choice DC, in writing, to provide me with the specific rule, guideline, or criterion that was relied on to deny my request. If the determination was made using a licensed clinical criteria product such as InterQual, I am requesting **the subset, edition, and full criteria text applied to my determination**, free of charge. Federal ERISA and ACA appeal rules require a plan to give a member, at no cost, the specific rule or criterion relied on for an adverse determination.

The plan's own policy supports this request. It states:

> "All criteria utilized in utilization management are available upon request."

and

> "To request specific utilization management criteria or to speak with a Medical Director, please contact us by phone during our normal business hours, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday through Friday at 1-(855)-798-4244."

and

> "Providers may request the UM criteria for UM decision making by calling the MedStar Family Choice DC Utilization Management Department at 1(855)-798-4244 or (202)- 363-4348 or fax (202)-243-6307 to make a request."

I am making that request here in writing as the member. I would also like to know the name and specialty of the reviewer who made this determination, and I am requesting a copy of my complete claim file for this request.

## What I am asking the plan to do

1. Overturn the denial dated 2026-08-03 (reference number POC-92D596C7F2-83353) and authorize lower back disc surgery / decompression, CPT 63030.
2. If the denial is maintained in whole or in part, identify in writing the specific document, finding, or data element that is considered missing from my file, and the specific criterion it is measured against, so that my surgeon and I can supply it.
3. Provide the full text of the criteria applied to my determination — including the subset and edition, if a licensed criteria product such as InterQual was used — along with my complete claim file, at no charge.
4. Have this appeal reviewed by a physician reviewer who practices in the specialty relevant to lumbar spine surgery.

I am also requesting that my surgeon, Dr. Lindqvist, be permitted to speak with a Medical Director about this case if that would help resolve it.

I have been living with this pain for 18 months, and I have done what was asked of me at every step: the physical therapy, the medication, the injection. I would be grateful for a careful second look. Please contact me at the phone number above if anything further is needed from me.

Thank you for your time and reconsideration.

Sincerely,

**Jordan Hayes**
Member ID: W671447302
[Signature]
[Date signed]

**Enclosures:**
- Copy of the Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-08-03
- [Physical therapy discharge note, 2026-04-14 to 2026-06-09]
- [MRI lumbar spine report, 2026-06-16]
- [Office notes and letter of medical necessity from Lindqvist, MD]
- [Medication and injection records]
- [Any additional records my provider's office submits]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
